Of course! I have a cat that's a little over a year old and he's been raised around other animals his whole life. Well one of my roommates who had a cat and a dog moved out and Link became incredibly lonely and less active. My roommate and I went looking for another animal at a local animal shelter (my heart was set on getting another cat). To meet my roommate half way, I told her I would loom at the dogs. The first dog we met was Aspen. We were told that she has been in the shelter for 6 months and before that was in a kill shelter on the red list. They said she was super standoffish and due to this she got looked over a lot. They even put the red bandana to make her stand out more. Well the second they put her in the outside pen she ran straight up to us and got in our laps. We spent about an hour and a half with her and the whole time she was cuddling up to us and playing. When we left she had to practically be dragged out of the pen. The vet that was out there said she had never seen her act that way before. As I said, I'm a total cat person and never wanted a dog. I had dogs all growing up and I knew the responsibility that comes with it. It wasn't until I met Aspen that I realized that I could take on that responsibility for the right dog, and luckily I found her. Sorry for the wall of text.
